title: OpenClaw native session key and epoch identity v1
description: Opaque session_id derived only from trusted native hook context. SHA256 over UTF8(openclaw-native-session/v1), NUL, UTF8(sessionKey), NUL, UTF8(sessionId). Key: 1..256 UTF8 bytes without C0/DEL and valid Unicode; epoch: lowercase UUID 8-4-4-4-12. This identifier is not authority or host attestation. See docs/openclaw-native-session-spec-v1.md.
